run_blt_demo: run the BLT model demo with a prompt using typer CLI to generate text completions
generate_text_with_blt: generate text completions from a prompt using the ByteLatentTransformer model and generate_nocache function
load_blt_model_and_tokenizer: load a consolidated BLT model and tokenizer from a checkpoint path using load_consolidated_model_and_tokenizer
setup_torch_distributed_for_blt: set up PyTorch distributed environment using DistributedArgs and setup_torch_distributed for BLT model inference
build_patcher_with_entropy_model: build a patcher with realtime patching enabled using patcher_args and an entropy model checkpoint
